body: This page stopped mid-ride. Try again — and if it keeps happening, tell us what you were doing.

drawer.description: A sentence or two is plenty. It goes straight to the people who can fix it.
drawer.done: Thank you. That helps more than you'd think.
drawer.failed: That didn't send. Try again in a moment.
drawer.placeholder: I tapped Save on my profile and the screen went blank.
drawer.title: Tell us what happened
drawer.tooShort: A few more words, please — at least ten characters.

title: The chain came off
